summary: Iteration 2 validated the new capabilities: uploads (multipart + query-auth download), audit cycles CRUD/RBAC/close-workflow, overdue reminder + in-memory dedupe, and the Google OAuth guard. All 9 new backend tests pass (100%). Frontend audit flow works end-to-end (create cycle → detail checklist → verify/missing/damaged → close). Reports page renders 4 charts + booking heatmap and Export-PDF fires without error. However, the Assets Register dialog is MISSING the FileUploader entirely (imported but never rendered), so photo/doc uploads from the UI are broken.

minor.issue: Query-param JWT auth works, but the token is visible in server access logs / referer headers. Acceptable for tags; consider short-lived signed tokens later.
No validation that end_date >= start_date; both accepted as arbitrary ISO strings.
Idempotent close returns {ok:true, message:'Already closed'} on the 2nd call — but omits missing_updated/damaged_updated keys the client relies on (minor).

ui_bugs.issue: FileUploader is imported (`import FileUploader from '@/components/FileUploader'`) and photos/docs local state exists, but NO <FileUploader .../> element is rendered inside the dialog. Result: the spec'd data-testid `assets-photo-uploader` does not exist in the DOM and users cannot attach photos/docs at asset registration. photo_urls posted to /api/assets is always [].

action_items: Render FileUploader components inside Assets.js RegisterDialog (both photo and doc uploaders) with data-testid='assets-photo-uploader' and 'assets-doc-uploader', wired to setPhotos/setDocs. Without this, photo_urls always submitted as empty array and AssetDetail photo gallery is never populated via the UI.
critical_code_review_comments: Assets.js: imports FileUploader and defines photos/docs state + submit maps photo_urls but the JSX inside RegisterDialog has NO uploader element. Dead code path — spec broken.
server.py is now ~1290 lines (previously ~1030). Uploads, audit, overdue live in the same monorouter. Split into routers/{uploads,audit,overdue}.py — soft limit is 700 lines.

scheduler.py: `_notified_today` is a module-level in-memory dict — with multiple backend pods behind the ingress each replica has its own dedupe state so overdue may be double-notified in prod. Move dedupe key into MongoDB (e.g., a 'notification_dedupe' collection with TTL index on date).

storage.py: catches only 403 for storage-key refresh; a 401 response would silently pass through as raise_for_status(). Also `_storage_key` module global is not thread-safe under a threadpool call (asyncio.to_thread).

server.py L1073 (mark_audit_item): does not check the marked cycle actually matches item's cycle_id when computing RBAC — currently OK because the cycle is looked up via item.cycle_id, but if `cycle` is None (deleted) the code will NPE on `cycle['status']`.
server.py `POST /api/audit/cycles/{id}/close` idempotent branch returns dict missing keys the client expects — either raise 400 for 'already closed' or return the same shape.
server.py `POST /api/audit/cycles`: no cross-field validation (end_date < start_date accepted).
clean_user() is called on `to_user`/`assignee` responses that already had `password_hash` stripped by the projection — safe but wasteful.
get_current_user accepts both JWT and Emergent session_token via same Bearer header — subtle overload; distinguish via prefix or endpoint.

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9 new tests, iteration1 regression not re-run)
success_rate.frontend: 83% (5/6 flows OK — FileUploader missing on Assets register)

seed_data_creation: Backend seed creates admin+manager+head+employee, 3 departments, 5 categories, 6 assets, 1 active + 1 returned allocation, 1 maintenance request, 3 activity_logs. Tests add TEST_ prefixed audit cycles & assets.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend iteration2 tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2.py — all pass (9/9). Iteration1 suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (18/19, brute-force lockout still tracked). Only frontend blocker is FileUploader not rendered in Assets RegisterDialog — fix by inserting <FileUploader testId='assets-photo-uploader' accept='image/*' onChange={setPhotos} /> and a docs counterpart around the photo_url field. AssetDetail.js already renders photo_urls via AuthedImage. Audit + Reports pages fully functional. PDF export via jspdf+html2canvas fires without error (cannot verify download bytes in playwright).
rca of the issue: Assets.js RegisterDialog: line 16 imports FileUploader; lines 143-144 hold photos/docs state; line 155-156 submit `photo_urls: photos.map(p=>p.url)` — but the JSX between lines 174-236 never renders a FileUploader. So `photos` and `docs` remain [] indefinitely. Confirmed via playwright: `data-testid=assets-photo-uploader` returns null after opening the register dialog. Fix: add two <FileUploader> components (photo + doc) with the required testIds inside the dialog body.
